Subject: AWS co-sell gating items — clarifications

Hi all,

Priya here from the AWS Marketplace & Co-sell desk — Samir flagged a potential joint listing with CloudResell + Redwood and asked me to weigh in on co-sell mechanics. A couple of clarifying notes so your ops team doesn't get surprised: 

1) Co-sell qualification: for AWS co-sell we need a validated solution brief, a commercial offer (pricing SKU(s)) and a field enablement pack that includes at least one seller-facing battlecard. The seller-facing materials should explicitly call out net-new ARR motion and partner responsibility for lead follow-up.

2) Technical evidence: a simple architecture diagram showing where customer data flows (what stays in customer VPC vs. vendor-managed) and a short note on data retention/defaults is required for listing approval.

3) Timeline expectations: once the package is submitted we typically see ~6-8 weeks for review + listing if there are no major compliance gaps. If you want expedited review for co-sell, we can route through the partnerships concierge but need a signed partnership scoping doc and commercial commitment from the ISV side.

Attaching: aws_co-sell_guidelines_v2.docx (internal guidance)

Happy to join the sync if helpful on vendor gating items.

Best,

Priya Rao
Senior Partner Solutions Manager — AWS Marketplace
